questions.question: What major celebration is described in chapter 12?
options: A great harvest feast in the autumn
The crowning of a governor as king
The royal wedding of a young Judean prince
The dedication of the wall of Jerusalem
questions.answer: The dedication of the wall of Jerusalem

questions.question: How did they dedicate the wall?
options: With the careful reading of the whole of the law from morning to noon
With two great choirs giving thanks, with music and rejoicing
With a great sacrifice offered silently before the LORD
With a solemn fast and a day of mourning for past sins
questions.answer: With two great choirs giving thanks, with music and rejoicing
